name: The Collector's Set
title: A set, completed
text: The Collector tips his hat and the shop exhales. Somewhere, a shelf you will never see has one less gap.

name: The Regulars' Last Chapter
title: The story is told
text: A regular's tale ends at your counter. The bell rings, the lamp steadies, and nobody asks for change.

name: Beyond Saving
title: The shop keeps you
text: Rent paid, doors open, and the shelves are humming. The shop is cursed past saving, and so, you note, are you.

name: Debt-Free
title: Paid in full
text: Every rent paid, every lamp lit. You own a pawnshop and nothing owns you. Tonight, at least.
